title: Differential of U
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express dU in terms of dT and dV using the given heat capacity.

title: State Variable Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the relationships among constants a through f based on the total differential condition.

title: Expression for U
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct functional form of U(T,V) based on previous results.

title: Pressure and Internal Energy Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the relationship between pressure and internal energy for an ideal gas.

title: Restrictions on Constants
description: Important Criteria: The student must identify the necessary conditions on constants a through f for the gas to be ideal.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common mistakes such as incorrect signs or missing factors in the equations.
